description: Move budgeted money from one category to another for a month. Creates no transaction.

amount.description: Amount to move (human-readable, e.g., 114.06). Must be positive.

from.description: Category to take the money from (name or ID)

month.description: Month (YYYY-MM or natural language). Defaults to the current month.

to.description: Category to give the money to (name or ID)

name: transfer_between_categories
